name: Fire Safety Inspection
description: Inspection of buildings and fire safety equipment to identify potential fire hazards.

name: Fire Extinguisher Refilling
description: Refilling and servicing of fire extinguishers after use or when maintenance is required.

name: Fire Alarm Inspection
description: Testing and inspection of fire alarm systems to ensure connected devices are functioning correctly.

name: Fire Safety Training
description: Training on fire prevention, emergency response, evacuation procedures, and proper extinguisher use.

name: Fire Risk Assessment
description: Assessment of a property to identify fire hazards and recommend appropriate safety measures.

name: Emergency Evacuation Planning
description: Development of an emergency evacuation plan including exit routes, assembly areas, and emergency procedures.
